facts: The authors report untrained ChatML boundary embeddings in Qwen2.5 Base models and warn against using them unchanged for Base inference or tuning.
They also report indefinite generation when padding and end-of-document handling interact incorrectly during fine-tuning.
sources.limits: The padding warning is pipeline dependent; it is not evidence of a defect in our unpadded native corpus with supervised Instruct end-of-turn tokens. These findings warrant explicit Base serialization checks rather than assuming a weight swap is controlled.

For Qwen conversational training, the documented EOS setting aligns with the end-of-turn token.

procedure_comparison.jovovich_reference: Completed counterbalanced-review experiment in PR 11; local experimental details supplied by the root agent and archive summary, not inferred from external sources.

trainable_scope.denominator_limit: 0.49 billion is the official rounded model-family count. Percentage is approximate; adapter count is exact for these shapes and rank.
trainable_scope.effect: At the measured decision position, the adapter transforms a frozen final-attention contextual representation. It does not adapt attention weights or earlier blocks.

optimization.voice_and_code_rows: 24 rows used for readout only, not optimized
optimization.objective: Separately normalized decision and residual cross-entropy with residual coefficient one; not identical to an ordinary uniform completion-token SFT objective.

interpretation: Official examples train attention projections or all linear layers; neither retrieved example restricts learning to the final MLP.
The known successful exact-model experiments use many distinct examples; repeated exposure to 52 review rows is not equivalent to that diversity.
One hundred visits per target means the raw update count alone cannot diagnose insufficient training. It also does not establish convergence.
LR1e-4 appears in an official family example and the exact-model commit experiment; its value alone is not evidence of a bug.
Our base is Q8_0; the reported comparison experiments use different precision and training implementations, adding another uncontrolled difference.
Adapter reach, objective normalization, dataset construction, checkpoint choice, and duration remain distinct hypotheses. No source establishes which causes our result.

commit_adapter_parameter_comparison.status: Derived from official dimensions and retrieved adapter configuration; not a direct inspection of its weight tensors.
commit_adapter_parameter_comparison.interpretation: Same rank sixteen corresponds to approximately 31.8 times as many trainable adapter parameters when applied across these projections in all 24 layers. This demonstrates a scope difference, not causality.

base_hypothesis.status: Plausible controlled ablation, not established cause.
support: Official documentation offers Base for custom downstream training.
Different post-training histories can change task priors and frozen representations.
counterevidence: Official documentation also offers Instruct for downstream tuning.
Several primary sources report successful task adaptation from the exact Instruct checkpoint.
required_controls: Pin and inspect both checkpoint configurations and tokenizers.
Choose and document Base serialization and terminal targets; do not silently inherit Instruct assumptions.
Separate an equal-input representation comparison from a task-training comparison where serialization might need to differ.
Keep held-out families, metrics, adapter reach, and optimization exposure fixed when those are the controlled variables.
base_hypothesis.recommended_next_action: Complete the frozen-representation readout probe. Use its outcome to choose a single subsequent intervention. A Base comparison may be informative but should not replace missing controls or be described as the cure.

negative_findings: No primary source retrieved establishes that Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Instruct is intrinsically unsuitable for fine-tuning.
No source retrieved establishes final-MLP-only LoRA as sufficient for contextual code review.
No source provides a validated minimum number of examples or updates for JOVOVICH.
No external result diagnoses a notorch defect.
citation_note: Root agent should reopen the cited primary pages before citing them to the user. Web reference identifiers are included for retrieval, not as substitutes for stable URLs.
